metric_definitions.request_error_rate: Failed HTTP requests / all measured HTTP requests; prespecified stop when > 0.05.
metric_definitions.session_failure_rate: Sessions without successful write-back / all attempted sessions at this level; one session may issue many requests.
metric_definitions.turn_latency_ms: Observed chat-turn HTTP attempts, including errors; sessions failing before those turns contribute no later latency (survivorship).

notes: Single uvicorn process unless --uvicorn-workers > 1; SQLite is the consultation store (writer lock serialises commits).
FHIR write latency is the POST fhir-composition round trip (backend + HAPI).
Run-created Encounters and captured write references are deleted after each level.
